modules.name: Discovery and delivery planning
modules.description: Resolve scope and delivery uncertainties, then coordinate delivery.

tasks.title: Clarify launch scope and timeline
tasks.description: Confirm the phase-1 capabilities, reconcile the conflicting six-week and approximately three-month timeline statements, and document dependencies and delivery milestones.
tasks.rationale: The launch timeline is contradictory, and checkout inclusion in phase 1 is not established.

tasks.title: Project management and communication
tasks.description: Coordinate stakeholders, decisions, dependencies, risks, and delivery status throughout the project.
tasks.rationale: Ongoing coordination is needed across product, design, platform, and integration work.

modules.name: Product design
modules.description: Create the visual design foundation and high-fidelity interface specifications.

tasks.title: Produce high-fidelity mockups and component styles
tasks.description: Create high-fidelity mockups and a reusable component style system for the agreed storefront screens and responsive public pages.
tasks.rationale: The brief explicitly requests high-fidelity mockups and component styles; screen scope depends on platform and launch decisions.

modules.name: Identity and access
modules.description: Support customer authentication, enterprise SSO, and role-based data access.

tasks.title: Implement registration, login, and password reset
tasks.description: Build user registration, login, email verification, and password-reset flows, including the required backend authentication behavior.
tasks.rationale: These account flows are explicit requirements and need server-side identity and verification handling.

tasks.title: Build account authentication screens
tasks.description: Implement the user-facing registration, login, email verification, and password-reset screens for the selected delivery platform.
tasks.rationale: Authentication requires user-facing flows in addition to backend services; exact platform remains undecided.

tasks.title: Integrate client identity provider for enterprise SSO
tasks.description: Confirm the client's identity provider and implement the agreed SSO protocol and configuration; do not assume Azure AD until confirmed.
tasks.rationale: Enterprise SSO is required, but the provider is explicitly unconfirmed.

tasks.title: Define and enforce role-based data access
tasks.description: Implement admin access across all data and, once clarified, enforce whether regional managers can access only their own region.
tasks.rationale: Admin access is specified, while regional-manager restrictions are an open policy decision with data-isolation implications.

modules.name: Storefront experience
modules.description: Deliver the dashboard, core user flows, and responsive public pages.

tasks.title: Provide dashboard data and filtering APIs
tasks.description: Implement backend data retrieval and filtering needed by dashboard widgets, including appropriate empty-result responses.
tasks.rationale: Dashboard widgets and filters require data services; exact widget definitions and data sources need product clarification.

tasks.title: Build dashboard widgets, filters, and empty states
tasks.description: Implement the dashboard interface with widgets, filters, and designed empty states on the selected delivery platform.
tasks.rationale: The dashboard is an explicit user-facing requirement, but its detailed content and platform are not yet specified.

tasks.title: Implement core user-flow screens
tasks.description: Build the agreed core user-flow screens using the platform selected during discovery; confirm whether delivery is native or cross-platform before implementation.
tasks.rationale: Core screens are required, but the delivery platform is explicitly undecided.

tasks.title: Build responsive public pages and SEO basics
tasks.description: Implement public-facing pages with responsive layouts and foundational SEO metadata and page structure.
tasks.rationale: Public pages, responsive behavior, and SEO basics are explicit requirements.

modules.name: Notifications
modules.description: Deliver transactional email and mobile push notification capabilities.

tasks.title: Implement templated transactional email delivery
tasks.description: Integrate an email delivery service and implement transactional email templates and triggering behavior for agreed events, including account verification and reset flows.
tasks.rationale: Transactional email is required, but the provider and full event/template inventory are unspecified.

tasks.title: Implement mobile push notifications
tasks.description: Integrate a push-notification service and deliver notifications for agreed key events, including any required device-token registration and backend dispatch.
tasks.rationale: Push notifications are required, but provider, event definitions, and mobile platform are undecided.

modules.name: Payments
modules.description: Support card checkout if confirmed for the delivery scope.

tasks.title: Implement card payment checkout
tasks.description: Integrate a payment provider and implement card checkout, including backend payment handling and the user-facing checkout flow, if included in the agreed phase-1 scope.
tasks.rationale: Card checkout is requested, but phase-1 inclusion and the payment provider are unspecified; frontend checkout work should be estimated separately once scope is confirmed.

tasks.title: Build card checkout interface
tasks.description: Implement the user-facing card checkout screens and payment states if checkout is confirmed for the agreed scope and platform.
tasks.rationale: Checkout requires a user interface, but phase-1 inclusion, provider, and delivery platform are unresolved.

modules.name: Platform and quality
modules.description: Set up delivery infrastructure and provide review and quality assurance.

tasks.title: Set up CI/CD pipelines
tasks.description: Configure automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for the selected application platform and environments.
tasks.rationale: CI/CD is a necessary delivery task even though it is not called out as a product feature.

tasks.title: Set up development, test, and production environments
tasks.description: Provision and configure the environments and application configuration needed to build, validate, and release the agreed solution.
tasks.rationale: Environment setup is required for implementation and release; exact hosting and platform choices remain to be confirmed.

tasks.title: Perform code review
tasks.description: Review implementation changes for correctness, maintainability, and alignment with agreed engineering conventions.
tasks.rationale: Code review is a required hidden delivery activity across the implementation.

tasks.title: Perform QA and regression testing
tasks.description: Test agreed user flows, integrations, responsive behavior, access rules, and regression coverage across supported platforms and environments.
tasks.rationale: QA and regression testing are required hidden tasks; coverage depends on the final platform, scope, and integration decisions.
